visualReview.scope: Completed stadium exterior and visible football bowl.
visualReview.notes: All fifteen current portable and fifteen shared frames inspected. Full-size final entry, membrane and geographic views confirm corrected MARSEILLE reading direction, smooth pillow bays, denser alternating facade panels and entrance doors meeting the upper stair landings. Independent four-support roof, double-layer lattice, bolted bases, curved skirt, seating and diagonal screens are visible.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Metric shared membrane, concrete and painted metal are coherent at close and distant scales. Local glazing, white chairs and pitch colors remain portable. Geographic sky-PMREM and unload assertions passed.

geographicReview.notes: Mapped pitch long edge resolves north-northwest direction. Exact asymmetric roof trace matches the geographic outline, with Jean Bouin on west +X and Ganay seating lettering on east -X. Close apron is terrain-contact at nativeY0; small support footings extend0.1m below.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed published exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: Primary SCAU completed photographs, FHECOR executed steelwork diagrams and contractor/operator evidence support the individual four-lobed roof, suspended skirt and facade. Exact structural sections, membrane panel inventory, chair count and local vertical street gradients remain architectural reconstructions. Enclosed rooms, sponsor graphics and surrounding commercial district are outside the permanent exterior asset.

sharedHelperAdoption.change: Adopts commit 730813689 (2026-10-26): the shared stadium-models.mjs curve() helper, used for this stadium's rails, ring cables and frames, switched from one tube() per segment to a continuous tubePath() with shared miter rings and caps only at open ends. That removed overlapping segment caps and seams at every joint; nothing else in the model changed. The source pin had stayed at the pre-change output, which the build has not produced since that commit.
sharedHelperAdoption.evidence: The shared helper is not one of this model's listed recipes, so its input hash did not move while its output did. Regenerating with only that helper reverted reproduced the previous source pin exactly. Portable and shared-surface frames were recaptured from the current model and inspected; the existing review statuses and notes are retained.
